notes: Our Story: founder Becky Hosmer started Anna Beck in 2003 during a trip to Bali; works with heritage artisans in Bali. FAQ: pieces are 18k gold or rose gold plated over solid .925 sterling silver; repairs go back to the workshop in Bali. Products: 'Handmade in Bali', engravable pendants.
Shipping: US orders $250+ free UPS Ground, $10 below; Canada $25, other international $45. Returns: refund, exchange or store credit within 30 days of receipt; sale and engraved items final.
